verified_title: DreamVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model Dreamed with Comprehensive World Knowledge
problem: Full-frame prediction can waste capacity on static backgrounds while omitting motion, depth and semantic cues relevant to control. Unrestricted interaction among heterogeneous future queries may inject irrelevant gradients.
contribution: Train a GPT2-style policy with separate dynamic-region, depth and semantic future queries. Structured attention isolates target types; a diffusion action head uses their latent embedding while prediction decoders are omitted at inference.
algorithm: Frozen CLIP text and MAE visual features plus state tokens enter a multimodal transformer. CoTracker identifies moving patches for masked reconstruction. Depth targets come from sensors or DepthAnythingV2 with scale normalization. Semantic targets use DINO/SAM features. Separate query groups cannot read each other directly; the model jointly trains these objectives with diffusion action prediction. The final preferred semantic target is SAM because adding DINO can hurt.
observations: Static and wrist RGB with EE pose and binary gripper state. Scale-normalized monocular depth preserves relative structure, rather than guaranteed metric geometry. Prediction heads operate only during training.
actions: 7D EE displacement/gripper vectors. The appendix specifies current plus2future steps, a3-frame chunk, no past-action context and10 inference denoising steps. Physical control frequency and NX latency are NOT_EXTRACTED.
embodiment_and_data: CALVIN language-free and DROID pretraining; LIBERO90 pretraining before per-suite fine-tuning. Physical FrankaPanda uses two D415 RGB cameras and100 demonstrations/task for grasp, place and drawer tasks. Training uses8A800 GPUs; precomputed teacher features trade extra storage for lower training-time computation.
experiments: CALVIN ABC-to-D uses1000 five-task rollouts; LIBERO reports four suites. Physical trials randomize objects/drawer and permit up toTWENTY consecutive attempts PER TRIAL. Success uses grasp, placement or drawer displacement over10cm. Total physical trial denominator is NOT_EXTRACTED. Ablations compare target types, present reconstruction versus future prediction, optical flow versus motion regions, attention and query counts.
baselines: DiffusionPolicy, OctoBase and OpenVLA on the authors' physical demonstrations; published CALVIN VLA/video policies and controlled query/target variants. Checkpoints are selected by validation success; a reproduction must retain independent final evaluation data.
limitations: Twenty attempts per trial can conceal frequent control failures. Monocular depth does not establish metric contact geometry, and motion masks can capture camera motion or irrelevant objects. RGB-centric parallel grippers and limited material diversity constrain scope. Navigation, humanoid and complex cloth tasks are future work. Main cosine scheduling/weight decay1e-4 conflicts with appendix constant scheduling/0.01 and needs pinned-source verification.
code_and_license: No source commit, model weights, teacher licenses or training-data terms audited; no execution. Derived pseudo-label features require separate provenance and rights review.
hardware_adaptation: ADAPT motion-region future-feature supervision to an ACT-sized policy offline, testing one auxiliary target at a time with matched data/compute. Keep actual RGB/depth distinct from pseudo-depth and forecasts. Count first-attempt success separately from recovery. Three-frame Cartesian actions and two-view Franka geometry cannot be directly mapped to SO101/M3 commands. Existing controller settings remain unchanged.
